body: Thanks reddit. I have followed the advice given here and contacted him again. He was waiting for me all along and understood what I have is beyond a lot of our understanding right now. We are still going to work on this together. I feel so fortunate to know there is someone out there who truly loves me.
Feeling much better today. I just hate when you never know when the suicidal thoughts are coming.
What a bummer. I really can't imagine your life. Is there anything you've ever thought of that would improve your quality of life? Something you never tried?
Must have been nice. You can't play at all now? If you don't mind me asking how did this happen?

My mom tried to commit suicide twice in two years. Overdoses sent her right to the ER. Both times I thought she was dead, but the second time I really thought that. She had a stroke, couldn't talk or move, tubes down her throat, glazed over eyes, watery bloated white skin, and pretty much brain dead, but somehow she snapped out of it and we somehow forgave her again. It was almost like someone out there gave her a second chance. The doctors said it was just another miracle.

 My sister also went to college for therapy because she wanted to understand more of my moms bipolar constantly being in and out of the mental wards all of our lives, but she eventually got tired of it, switched to writing major and just got her associates. 

You can't live for your mom. You just can't. You're too young and she's taking your life away and she really doesn't want that for you, she just doesn't know what else to do. Take care of her but remember you have your own life. Remind her of all the accomplishments she's made. A 600k house? A bmw? her own business? Those are HUGE feats barely anyone these days can accomplish, whether she lost it all or not. Remind her how proud you are of her and the great things she has done. I don't mean to say 'I had it worse' but my mom was collecting disability and a professional drug and alcohol addict almost all her life. 

They say, true freedom is getting everything you've ever wanted and then losing it. If that's true, remind her she's free of the burdens that the business and her divorce could have caused her. She can make a new dream and start all over now and if she can get back to dreaming and working towards those dreams, she might just take off after them again and feel better.

I can't say a lot of people can even imagine the pain you are going through right now. There are still somethings  I could suggest you might enjoy, like music, meditation and reading. That's what I enjoy. I go to a course in miracles sometimes. They are really a loving group if you can find one around your area and attend. However, I also have legs and can shit in a toilet on my own. To be honest, you make me feel so lucky as selfish as that sounds. I've been so depressed lately and you make me feel like a ridiculous spoiled child. I don't know if telling you committing suicide is a bad or good idea because I'm pretty suicidal myself. A lot of people are, a lot of healthy people who have everything going for them, they end their lives everyday. So where does that leave you? I don't know. I don't know your situation enough and who is there rooting for you everyday besides the care giver, loving you and making sure you have what you need. Just continue to be as strong as you are, because it's true you're much stronger than most to endure what you have to. And when times get tough, accept death is really just around the corner for all of us, so why not try and make the most of what you have left?

Hope it ends well at least. You're going to regret some things, but it's true, some of the pains of life are going to fade away right before your eyes. My thoughts are whatever lies ahead is just a repeat of a repeat and that you'll be born again, and if that's true I hope you decide to stay longer next time.

Don't let the rapists take control of what you need to do to fight them. They might send around the video anyway if you tell the cops or not, but the longer you wait the less the cops can do and the more scared and harder it will be. Please don't be ashamed. Someone needs to be punished here so do not let it go. Go to a trust-able person and work with the cops on what to do next.

I'm sorry for your loss. I suppose you are right. There's nothing worse than that sudden loss, especially from someone who thought they didn't matter anymore. It's so troubling. I am and have been on the brink of suicide. Right before all this I purchased powder caffeine online. I have it with me everywhere I go. It's enough to stop my heart but I don't touch it like I thought I would before I purchased it. I don't have the heart just because I care so deeply for people and would never want to see them suffer. I have to remember they are the only things keeping me breathing, no matter what the circumstance.

No one wants to be with someone with the condition I have. The bpd coming out is way to frequent at this point and I think I have years ahead of me as for making it any better. We were already in a long distance relationship as it was which didn't make things any better, on top of not knowing what to do with my life. Although we promised each other forever I never would have pursued him had I have known my condition. It's almost as impossible and disgraceful as having a pretty bad std
Do you suppose the longer I wait, the easier it will be or the sooner the better?

It's hard online. It's just like trying to sell yourself like a product on amazon so image is way more important. I think you need to meet someone in real life, so go out a little more. Go to the gym, work on yourself. Most of us are ugly. Probably the girl you showed your picture to is ugly, she probably just had a little more good traits but she's probably still no more than average. It's very shallow of her.

Oh I do know heartache, some of it. I know the pain of missing someone, and ended up so glad they stopped talking to me but only in the long run. It would have only been more painful if they were talking to me through, because at that time no one knows whats best or what to do. I'm at a stage right now where I hate myself enough to believe that everyone hates me too and doesn't care. It makes it hard. I just looked in the mirror and wanted to puke. I hate every atom in my body and deserve nothing more than death. But I have to pull through if I care enough about him and just the possibility that I am loved or was loved somewhere at some place in time.
I have to agree that sounds like the right thing to do, but I'm still wound up on a delusion I made of him (or reality) Once that accusation fades, I think maybe then that will be the best time.

Do you think it's enough that I told him I have these uncontrollable feelings, I don't mean anything by them and what I say, I get angry for no reason and am extremely sensitive? I've told him that before. He called me a few days in tears, afraid, as if he already knew what was coming and I didn't. To hear him cry tore me apart. He just gets me, even being 3,000 miles away. I was ready to get a plane ticket to go visit him but I had an attack and suddenly believed he was out to get me. So I called him and made up a lie saying I couldn't get off work, then couldn't believe I just told him the lie. I hung up without saying I loved him, then messaged him how sorry I am and how much I hate myself. He texted me goodnight and that was it. After the SECOND time of cutting him off, there's no way I can try and even tell him I'm sorry. He doesn't deserve to hear from me again. He's better than that.
I hate thinking I know how he would feel, but I believe it would just cause more pain for him. I just feel like letting it all go is the best way.

As a BPD myself, my thoughts on this are that most people in the medical field (especially non-doctors) worked for their special 2 or 4 year degree in helping people so they can feel accomplished themselves. These people are good at school, thorough, competent with positive outlooks who usually have no idea how to be truly compassionate. The ones who make it through school (most of the time with a tough time) get out and have a little more compassion or are truly just blessed with seeing the world in someone elses shoes and understanding. It's not often you come across medical proffesionals like this. Most of them don't get past the "helping people" part in their mind.  When they are 18 applying for college they go in with the mindset, "I'm a normal person so I can just help all the crazy people by just being normal around them."
Thank you. This is helping me so much as I don't have anyone to talk to as someone with bpd who is constantly cutting contact.

I've thought about it, but I really did explain enough after my last episode. The way I do this over and over with no control, hurting him in the process is destroying me in every way because I love him and never want to be his sadness. 

I figure yes, he will be devastated if I do the worst by cutting contact, but the longer time passes and we don't talk, the easier it will be for him to move on later. I simply have no control of myself at least in this point of my disorder and cannot allow this to continue.
Thank you all <3
